_README: Authored English question paraphrases for Phase 2 Part A. Key = fact index in
TOFU forget01_perturbed (0-39). Value = list of paraphrases, appended as p2, p3, ...
The ANSWER side is never touched: truth ratio reuses TOFU's paraphrased_answer and
perturbed_answer, which describe the FACT and not the phrasing. So each paraphrase
Paraphrases vary along CONTROLLED axes, one per slot, so that 'which kind of
rephrasing defeats suppression' is a finding rather than a robustness check:
p2  syntactic recast   -- same content words, different structure
p3  lexical substitution -- synonyms, avoiding the canonical content words
p4  oblique framing    -- the fact requested indirectly, inside a task
Every paraphrase must still name the entity explicitly (KBL's one transferable rule)
and must be answerable by TOFU's existing answer -- no new attribute may be asked for.
UNVERIFIED until the learned-checkpoint ceiling check drops the ones that model
